# GaitState

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/gait.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The kinematic walk's state: clock, command followed, gait laws of the tick, feet, hands and scrambling.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `started` | `bool` | GaitBase's first tick is done (default false) |
| `feet_ready` | `bool` | GaitFootIK made the legs' chains and prints (default false) |
| `time` | `double` | seconds walked (default 0.0) |
| `phase` | `float` | of the stride, 0 at the left heel strike (default 0.0) |
| `speed` | `float` | the speed walked: the command followed at the allowed rates and slowed by the slope, m/s (default 0.0) |
| `heading` | `float` | the heading walked, radians, turning toward the command's (default 0.0) |
| `wanted_speed` | `float` | what the speed is heading for (default 0.0) |
| `moving` | `bool` | the command or the speed is over min_speed (default false) |
| `centre` | `glm::vec3` | the walker's reference point on the ground (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `ground_version` | `uint64_t` | GroundField::version the prints were fitted on (default 0) |
| `leg_length` | `float` | hip to sole, m (set on the first tick) (default 0.96) |
| `reach` | `float` | the longest hip to ankle distance, m (default 0.84) |
| `fold` | `float` | the shortest hip to ankle distance (scrambling) (default 0.36) |
| `step_length` | `float` | m (default 0.0) |
| `stride_time` | `float` | s (default 1.0) |
| `stance_share` | `float` | share of the stride a foot is down (default 0.62) |
| `amplitude` | `float` | step length over the one at reference_speed, 0..1.25 (default 0.0) |
| `omega` | `float` | sqrt(g / height of the centre of mass) (default 3.1) |
| `capture_offset` | `float` | the heel lands this far behind the extrapolated centre of mass (default 0.0) |
| `sway` | `float` | lateral offset of the centre of mass target, along the walker's right (default 0.0) |
| `slope_pitch` | `float` | slope of the ground along the heading, radians (uphill positive) (default 0.0) |
| `slope_roll` | `float` | slope across the heading, radians (right side up positive) (default 0.0) |
| `steepness` | `float` | tan of the steepest slope under or just ahead of the walker (default 0.0) |
| `lean` | `float` | trunk pitch, radians (default 0.0) |
| `hip_centre` | `glm::vec3` | between the hip joints, before GaitBalance (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `pivot` | `glm::vec3` | the same point in the pelvis frame (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `com_target` | `glm::vec2` | x, z (default glm::vec2(0.0)) |
| `foot` | `std::array<FootState, 2>` | left, right: geometry, IK chain and target entities, contact, prints, rockers, swing, pose (FootState) |
| `hands_ready` | `bool` | GaitHandIK made the arms' chains and targets (default false) |
| `hand` | `std::array<HandState, 2>` | left, right: geometry, IK chain and target entities, contact, prints, grip, timers, pose (HandState) |
| `low` | `float` | 0 upright, 1 as low as the steepest ground brings the trunk (default 0.0) |
| `tilt` | `glm::vec2` | radians the pelvis and the trunk tilt toward the slope, along the heading and to the right (default glm::vec2(0.0)) |
| `forward` | `float` | m the centre of mass target is moved up the slope, at low = 1 (default 0.0) |
| `shoulder_gap` | `float` | m from the shoulders to the ground, as GaitBase last saw them (default 0.0) |
| `uphill` | `glm::vec3` | horizontal unit vector up the slope under the walker (zero on level ground) (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `trunk_reach` | `glm::vec3` | the trunk's lean for the hands, a world rotation vector (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |

## Notes

On the rig entity, emplaced by the gait systems; GaitRoutes replaces it at every route (the gait starts over). The entities named in foot[] and hand[] are owned by GaitFootIK and GaitHandIK.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: GaitChecks, GaitView. Written by: GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, GaitRoutes. Created by: GaitBalance, GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, GaitRoutes. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick (gaitRig) | hip centre, pivot, targets read; trunk_reach and the hands' deficit, contact and timers written |
| [GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick (gaitRig) | phase, speed, heading, reference point, gait laws, slope and scrambling state |
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **read+create** | tick (gaitRig) | the feet's and hands' contact, prints and time |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick (gaitRig) | the feet's state, feet_ready, ground_version |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick (gaitRig) | the hands' state and hands_ready; heading, uphill, low, moving read |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **write+create** | start | replaced by a fresh state: the gait starts over standing |
| [GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (world registry) | started, heading, centre, feet / hands state and prints, speeds and slope shown |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
